title: buildzr config file (buildzr.yaml, version 1)
description: buildzr.yaml: the workspace file, build options and named deploy targets. Text values may use ${NAME}, ${NAME:-fallback} and $$; they are expanded when a command uses them, so values that contain '$' are only checked for their type here. Secrets never go in this file. Relative paths are relative to the folder holding the file. The loader (buildzr.site.config) is the authority; this schema lets editors check the same rules.

workspace.description: The DSL .py file that creates a Workspace.

out.description: Where build writes and serve reads by default.

default_target.description: Must name a key of targets. With exactly one target it is the default.

target.description: Exactly one of dir and url, plus an optional path.

url.description: Deploy address of a running instance (http:// or https://).

path.description: Site path below the root. Segments [a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]*, no '..'; leading and trailing '/' are removed.
